title: docs(approvals): a reject reason is required at every human door — contract docblock, docs, checklist and skill reference
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D62xGLMbyWJaMEVnAMEjTK1)_
Fixes #35772
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感,行为不变;开发者文档、接口说明和测试清单不再把"驳回理由"写成可选,而是写明驳回在每个人工入口都必须附理由。
- 为什么做:收尾"驳回必须附理由":上一轮已让审批接口、SDK 和收件箱都强制要求理由,但几处说明文字还停留在旧说法。
- 出错会怎样:只改说明文字,不影响任何运行行为;若某句写错,只会误导读者,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。对外发布的技能包那一句改动已移到单独的技能小卡,本 PR 不再触及需人工批准的文件。

## What changes

Text only; no behaviour change. On `origin/main` at `d9be915f40`, `ApprovalService.decide()` refuses a reject whose `comment` is missing, blank or not a string with `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` before anything is read or written; `client.approvals.reject` requires the comment; `approval_reject` declares it required; the console inbox keeps Reject disabled until a reason is typed. The email action link still records the fixed text "Via action link" (tracked separately). Five texts said otherwise:

- **`packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts`** — `ApprovalDecisionInput.comment` gains a docblock stating the rule (required, non-blank string on a reject; optional on an approve), in the style of the `outputs` member's own rule; the `IApprovalService.decide` docblock states it too. Docblock only: the type is unchanged (`comment?: string`), since narrowing it would be a contract change.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts`** — the `approval_reject` comment said "The target route itself does not judge the reason." It now says the route judges it again through `ApprovalService.decide()`.
- **`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx`** — the reject body in "The decision" shows `comment` without `?` and says it is the required reason; the decision-surface table row says a reject's `comment` is required at every human door; the `approval_reject` paragraph names every human door (action door, MCP `run_action`, the param dialog, the `/reject` route and the SDK through `decide()`, the inbox) and the email action link as the one exception.
- **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/approvals.json`** — `approvals.quorum-m-of-n` steps[7] sends a reason with the veto's `POST /reject` (revision 12 to 13); `approvals.inbox-keyboard-flow` steps[2] types a reason before confirming the `r`-key reject (revision 3 to 4). Each item gains a history row; no clause changed.

Changeset `.changeset/35772-reject-reason-required-texts.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/plugin-approvals` patch (both in the one `fixed` group). The spec docblock ships: after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, its new sentence is in `packages/spec/dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts`. The plugin comment ships too: esbuild's transform of the source file keeps the new comment (1 hit, control `approval_reject` 4 hits).

## Acceptance notes

- The skill reference moves to domain:skills sub-card #35817 (contract review S1 7036174996). Commit `1b1cc7fc97` restores `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` to `origin/main` and drops the `@objectstack/skills` line from the changeset, so this PR touches no `skills/**` path.

- Sweep of `content/docs`, `skills/` and `docs/qa` (excluding run records and the release-owned trees) for any other sentence calling a reject reason optional: none left in these trees. The skill reference does not call the reason optional; it only does not state the rule yet, which is #35817's. `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx` already passes a comment to `client.approvals.reject`. The `approvals.record-page-decisions` source line describes the action's own declaration and stays true. The `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` "optional comment" belongs to that scenario app's own action, not the platform reject.
- `approvals.json` changes were read from source at base `d9be915f40` and not re-run live; each history row says so.
- The docs link the email action link's fixed text to its own follow-up card; that card owns the confirm-page reason field.
